name: What if I want a bathroom remodel but only have a limited budget?

mainEntity.name: What if I want a bathroom remodel but only have a limited budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: A limited budget can still go a long way if you keep the layout, reuse what is in good condition, and focus on the highest-impact changes. Repainting, replacing the vanity, upgrading lighting, changing the mirror, and installing new fixtures can transform the room without a full gut job. Get a scope that separates must-haves from nice-to-haves so you can phase the work if needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: With a limited budget, keep the layout, reuse what works, and focus on high-impact updates like vanity, lighting, fixtures, and paint.
